technical.summary: Strong trend structure with golden cross and new highs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple oscillators create pullback risk; better suited for continuation on dips than immediate entry.

fundamental.summary: AME shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 84 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (47% fear-greed); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (275.36), imminent CPI event, and negative macro score (-6) create severe headwinds; earnings in 84 days poses no immediate binary risk but environment is highly unfavourable for equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + 20-day new high + ADX trending establish structural uptrend, and price near support (131.87) offers defined risk entry for continuation traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 87.8, Stoch 94.19), crisis VIX, inverted yield curve, zero fundamental support, and no smart money conviction create pullback risk that outweighs technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and 20-day new high establish uptrend structure, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 87.8, Stoch 94.19) combined with crisis macro environment create unfavourable risk/reward for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (275.36), and extreme oscillator overbought create high probability of pullback that could invalidate technical setup before continuation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical strength
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AME with 50 existing Industrials positions (14% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip new entry and monitor for pullback to support (131.87) if macro stabilizes.
